title: Grain multi-scenario diagnostic holdout
note: Diagnostic chrome-path holdout. Not Kenny's private maintainer bench. Not a KEEP scalar unless Jason says so later. Do not fit the SigLIP probe on these images. Do not replace the 358 broader proxy as a silent default ratchet. Public/legal sources only: Wikimedia Commons, OpenFake (already used in this repo), Lorem Picsum.

disjoint_from.broader_358: ofreddit_* (reddit/test first 90/class), ofhold_* (core/test skip 180 take 60), webai_* (reddit/test AI skip 90 take 30), webreal_* Picsum IDs in eval/download_broader.py WEB_PICSUM, picsum_* easy-real IDs.

categories.historic_scan_bw: Pre-1950 B&W/sepia film scans. REAL only. Includes the Charlesworth 1910s Golden Retriever photo.
categories.historic_scan_color: Early color / Autochrome / Prokudin-Gorsky / faded print scans. REAL only.
categories.wiki_web_real: Modern Wikipedia/Commons photographs as served on the web (JPEG, typical wiki widths). REAL.
categories.phone_web_real: Casual modern photos with web recompress (q≈65, max side 720). Picsum IDs not in the 358 mix. REAL.
categories.social_reddit_real: OpenFake reddit/test reals not already in the 358 manifest. REAL.
categories.social_reddit_ai: OpenFake reddit/test fakes not already in the 358. AI.
categories.gen_holdout_ai: OpenFake core/test after the 360 prefix and after the 358 ofhold_* files. AI.
categories.gen_holdout_real: Matching real holdout, disjoint from 360 and 358. REAL.
categories.screenshot_ui: Charts, UI screenshots, diagrams (graphic-gate case). Mix of real Commons screenshots and honestly labeled AI UI.
categories.compressed_thumb: Same images saved small (max side 250–400, q=60). derived_from points at the original id.
categories.ai_photoreal: Recent photoreal generators in OpenFake (SDXL/Flux/etc.). AI.
categories.ai_illustrated: Obviously illustrated / cartoon / Midjourney-style in OpenFake. AI.
